video.title: TOP AI tools to learn and build AI applications! #ai

transcript.text: Five tools you should definitely know to
build AI applications today. First is
OpenAI GPT models. OpenAI helps you add
intelligence to your applications. You
can build chat bots, write content,
answer questions, and even help users
with their tasks. Second is Langchain.
Langchain connects your AI models with
data and tools. You can use it to build
chat flows, agents, and step-by-step AI
actions. Third, vector databases. Vector
databases are used to store data in the
form of numbers or vectors called as
embeddings. These databases help AI find
most relevant information quickly.
Vector databases are used for semantic
search recommendation and rack systems.
Next is Olama VLM or Docker model
runner. These tools lets you run AI
models locally on your computer and it
is good for testing or learning purposes
or for using open-source AI models.
Number five is AI monitoring tools that
will help you see how your AI
applications are working. You can track
any errors, speed, or cost to fix
problems easily and to create quality AI
applications. Subscribe.
